title: pvCONVERGECFDCGNSReader
body:
## pvCONVERGECFDCGNSReader

Reads CONVERGE CFD post-processing files written in CGNS (.cgns): the volume mesh, surfaces and parcels (Lagrangian spray or particle data stored in PARCEL_DATA UserDefinedData_t nodes) into a partitioned dataset collection with mesh and parcel datasets. Parcels become point clouds whose arrays are chosen in ParcelArrayStatus. Several files in FileNames form a time series. Use pvCONVERGECFDReader for CONVERGE HDF5 (.h5) post files and pvCGNSSeriesReader for general CGNS output.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Mesh and parcel blocks have different arrays; extract the block you need (extractBlock) before filters that expect one dataset.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `CONVERGECFDCGNSReader`. Identity: `sources/CONVERGECFDCGNSReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Available cell variables. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to read. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ParcelArrayStatus` | Available parcel variables. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Available mesh point variables. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCONVERGECFDCGNSReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
